recommendation: 1. lings.com (Shopify, products.json + per-model collections): best machine-readable source for Husqvarna and GasGas OEM accessories (vendors 'Husqvarna PCA', 'GasGas PCA'); sku = part number, tags = MODEL_YY fitment. UK catalog/GBP; map EU model codes to US models.
2. yamahaonlineparts.com (Shopify): Yamaha GYTR and genuine accessories with part numbers; full model:year fitment list in the product page HTML Fitment block (and partial list in body_html).

3. triumphpartstore.com (Triumph Waukesha, custom Next.js, robots allow): TF 250-X / TF 450-X accessories (A96-A99 part numbers) with a server-rendered Year/Model fitment table on every part page; crawl via sitemap or the per-model Accessories category.

4. motosport.com (custom, robots allow product pages): Husqvarna TA, GasGas TA, GYTR, KTM PowerParts, Honda Genuine Accessories with manufacturer part numbers in static HTML; fitment is JS-loaded, so it is a cross-check/part-number source unless the fitment XHR is identified.

5. Honda (HRC/genuine accessories) and Kawasaki (KX/KRT accessories): no readable dealer feed found. kawasaki.com sitemap lists ~160 KX accessory URLs with part number + model code in the path, but the pages returned 'Page Not Found' to our server; powersports.honda.com returned Access Denied; the big OEM parts houses (partzilla, hondapartshouse, kawasakipartshouse, ronayers, babbitts) are behind Cloudflare. Still open and needs a different approach (browser-based read or a dealer data agreement).
